The '''Mangez system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. The system contained at least two [[Planet/Legends|planet]] upon which [[Lant Mining Corporation]] conducted underground metal [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. Two orbital [[Lormar-class Refinery Station|''Lormar''-class Refinery Stations]] were also present in the system, one of which was designated [[Lormar 23]]. Lant Mining Corporation planned on transporting a third ''Lormar''-class station to the system to assist with refinery operations.<ref name="FBS" />
